question: How do I apply for my pension when I retire?

nuggets.text: A member retires by written notification to the Board setting the effective date.
nuggets.quote: may retire at any time upon written notification to the Board setting forth the date the retirement is to become effective.

nuggets.text: The effective date is after the last day of service and not more than 90 days before the notice is filed.
nuggets.quote: The effective date of retirement shall be after the last day of service of the member, but shall not be more than 90 days prior to the filing of the notice of retirement.

nuggets.text: The employer may notify on behalf of a member who cannot.
nuggets.quote: If the member is physically or mentally unable to submit written notification of his intention to retire, the member's appointing authority may submit notification on his behalf.

nuggets.text: The Board of Trustees administers the system.
nuggets.quote: The Retirement System shall be administered by the Board of Trustees
